question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the following sentence.**

The people who live here have had the same kind of lifestyle __until hundreds of years.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **for hundreds of years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The context of the sentence implies that the people have had the same lifestyle continuously for a long period of time, not until a certain point in time.
 
• Therefore, "**until hundreds of years**" doesn't accurately convey the idea of maintaining the lifestyle over an extended duration.
